name: kimi-workflow
description: Native agent workflows with isolated scripts, resumable runs, and a task browser.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description: Run a JavaScript workflow in the current Kimi session using the internal agent harness. Use agent(prompt, { model, ... }), pipeline(items, ...stages), parallel(tasks), phase(name) and log(text). Every agent must specify its model explicitly. Returns a background runId; inspect it with Plugin method kimi-workflow.workflow.status and control it with kimi-workflow.workflow.control. Use this tool directly for workflows; CLI workers and shell orchestration are not needed.

tokenBudget.description: Shared output-token budget for this run; only set a target requested by the user.

prefixStaggerMs.description: Wait for a matching worker to begin responding before starting siblings (default 5000 ms; 0 disables).
